primary_experiment: Short-step boundary-aware NBO on the original stopped consumption-investment-preference economy
actor_training: Adam, lr=.002, batch=256, float64, one CPU thread; fit projected Hamiltonian maximizer of the analytic Bellman predictor; no optimal-value labels
actor_heads: c=.8, p=.8, theta=.2*tanh(network(t,u)); constant endpoint heads must be verified against the ORIGINAL continuous control set
sampling: fresh uniform time/preference training points; explicit first-layer zero wealth coefficients
selection: Every predeclared checkpoint retained and certified. No best-seed selection. Order ablation uses seed 1500, width 16, 2000 updates for each order.
refinement: Repeat seed 1500 final checkpoint on [16,128,96]. Refinement changes enclosure error, not training error.
failures: All failed cells, endpoint tests, target misses and optimizer failures retained. Invalid proof operations stop the affected certificate; no skipped cells.
comparison: Same-model controlled Markov-chain and semi-Lagrangian baselines with original stopping payoff, plus historical time-control comparator. Discrete values are not called continuous-time certificates.
arithmetic: R14 rational-Taylor interval check plus MPFR-directed rounding cross-check. Shared algebra and independent arithmetic are identified separately.
scope: The regional experiment is not the full t=0 solution. The full-horizon claim remains a separate review gate and is not inferred from regional success.
